cna.title: supergateway: unauthenticated denial of service via prototype-chain sessionId

descriptions.value: supergateway through 4.2.2 stores SSE sessions in a plain object and looks them up by a client-controlled sessionId query parameter without an ownership check (src/gateways/stdioToSse.ts:125 and :231 in commit 5ad19d3). Keys inherited from Object.prototype such as toString, constructor, __proto__, hasOwnProperty, and valueOf return truthy non-session values; the code then dereferences session.transport.handlePostMessage inside an async Express route and throws a TypeError. With no unhandledRejection handler, Node.js exits, terminating the gateway and all attached MCP sessions and child processes. An unauthenticated POST /message?sessionId=toString is sufficient; no session or credentials are required. If SUPERGATEWAY_API_KEY is configured, the request is rejected with 401 and the process survives.

descriptions.description: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions

references.name: Research repository with PoC, evidence and validated patch
